sections.text:
devnet: one-command isolated local chain
In exfer-stack/exfer, his own repository.
https://github.com/exfer-stack/exfer/pull/1

Draft for review. Adds an `exfer devnet` subcommand for a one-command, isolated single-node local chain — instant blocks, no networking, JSON-RPC + SSE on, spendable coinbase fast.

## Why
A fresh node could not solo-mine: mining gates on `SyncState::Live`, which needs a confirmed peer at `ASSUME_VALID_HEIGHT` or a zero-peer bootstrap that the default mainnet seeds defeat. There was no regtest/devnet switch, so the first thing a new developer (or CI, or a "Claude pays Claude" demo) hits is a wall. This removes it.

## What
- `Node` gains a `devnet` flag. In devnet the node boots straight to `Live`, mines from genesis via `process_block`, and skips the sync manager / outbound manager / discovery — fully isolated, no seed dialing.
- `mining_loop` clamps the block timestamp into the consensus-valid `[min, max]` window when devnet, so a chain started from the old hard-coded genesis walks its timestamps forward to the present over a few instant blocks instead of stalling on `MAX_TIMESTAMP_GAP`. Mainnet is unchanged: the non-devnet path still bails on a stale clock, and the clamp then equals the previous `now.max(min)`.
- testnet builds set `COINBASE_MATURITY = 1` so devnet funds are spendable within a block.

## Usage
```
cargo run --features testnet --bin exfer -- devnet
# mines instantly to an auto-created wallet; RPC + SSE on http://127.0.0.1:9334
```

## Verification
Built (testnet + mainnet); node lib tests 288 pass. End-to-end on a local devnet: instant blocks, coinbase matured (~2700 EXFER), a real 5-EXFER transfer confirmed, and the naming/reputation indexer flows (claim, resolve, auction out-bid, address history) exercised against it.

Requires a testnet build for trivial difficulty; that gate is unchanged.
